name: Rival Lines

player_documentary.look: premium editorial sports documentary: layered photographs, sticker cut-outs, big type, career timeline, data comparisons on white

match_analysis.look: professional tactical broadcast: real pitch, formation and passing-network graphics from event data, navy scoreboard overlays

voice.style: Energetic but professional football documentary narration: confident, clear and lively, never shouting, never slow.

data.source: StatsBomb Open Data (event data, not player tracking)
data.attribution_required: credit StatsBomb and show the StatsBomb logo wherever the analysis is shown or published

rules: three kinds of number are never mixed without saying so: verified career statistics, event-data-derived statistics, video-derived estimates
event locations are never presented as continuous player movement
no player position, heatmap, passing network or possession figure is invented; each is computed from the recorded events
photographs come from Wikimedia Commons with author, licence and source recorded
no broadcast footage is used; tactical visuals are original graphics
